title: Dembow Clap Morph
description: A sculpted reggaeton dembow clap-snare hit built from a tonal mid-register sine snap layered over a white-noise body. Placed in the signature dembow "~ x ~ x" pattern with ghost variations, the hit's tone, decay, grit and width evolve over 16 cycles via mutually-prime LFOs — growing from a dry click into a wider, crunchier slap and back, never settling into a static timbre.
code:
setcpm(100/4)
stack(
  // Star: tonal snap layer — short sine pitch-drop for the "crack" top
  note("<g3 g3 g3 ab3>/16").s("sine")
    .struct("~ x ~ x")
    .penv("<24 24 18 20>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay("<0.04 0.05 0.03 0.06>/11")
    .attack(0.001).decay(sine.slow(13).range(0.04, 0.12)).sustain(0).release(0.01)
    .lpf(sine.slow(7).range(900, 3200)).resonance(sine.slow(11).range(2, 9)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(sine.slow(17).range(1, 5)).lpattack(0.001).lpdecay(0.06)
    .crush(sine.slow(13).range(6, 14))
    .shape(sine.slow(7).range(0.1, 0.45))
    .pan(sine.slow(11).range(0.3, 0.7))
    .gain(0.85),
  // Support: noise body — the clap/snare broadband crack, kept subtle
  s("white")
    .struct("~ x ~ <x [x ~]>/16")
    .attack(0.001).decay(sine.slow(11).range(0.04, 0.14)).sustain(0).release(0.01)
    .hpf(sine.slow(17).range(800, 2400))
    .lpf(sine.slow(13).range(3000, 8000))
    .crush(sine.slow(7).range(8, 16))
    .shape(sine.slow(16).range(0.05, 0.3))
    .pan(sine.slow(13).range(0.25, 0.75))
    .gain(0.38)
)
